lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
The horizon's bleeding into gold
Stories in the engine yet untold
I'm keeping my hands upon the wheel
Savoring the way the shadows feel
[chorus]
I'm driving through the haze of the day
Watching all the worries melt away
Just me and the road in the light
Everything I need is in my sight
[verse]
Mirrors catching flickers of the past
Moving at a pace that's built to last
Don't need to answer to the noise
Finding all the rhythm in my poise
[chorus]
I'm driving through the haze of the day
Watching all the worries melt away
Just me and the road in the light
Everything I need is in my sight
[bridge]
Let the colors fade into the dark
I carry the flame, I carry the spark
Focused on the destination ahead
Living out the words that I said
[chorus]
I'm driving through the haze of the day
Watching all the worries melt away
Just me and the road in the light
Everything I need is in my sight
[outro]
